options.name: --raw
options.description: Save raw output, without timing or other metadata

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite the recording if it already exists

name: -c
--command
options.description: Specify command to record, defaults to $SHELL

name: -e
--env
options.description: List of environment variables to capture

name: -t
--title
options.description: Specify the title of the asciicast

name: -i
--idle-time-limit
options.description: Limit recorded terminal inactivity to max amount of seconds

options.name: --cols
options.description: Override terminal columns for recorded process

options.name: --rows
options.description: Override terminal rows for recorded process

name: -y
--yes
options.description: Answer “yes” to all prompts (e.g. upload confirmation)

subcommands.name: play
subcommands.description: Replay recorded asciicast in a terminal

subcommands.name: cat
subcommands.description: Print full output of recorded asciicast to a terminal

subcommands.name: upload
subcommands.description: Upload recorded asciicast to asciinema.org site

subcommands.name: auth
subcommands.description: Link and manage your install ID with your asciinema.org user account
